sandbachFocus: League leaders Sandbach United host Alsager Town on Saturday 3 October at 15:00, looking to bounce back after their most recent defeat. Sandbach remain top with 22 points from 10 games despite that loss, and face an Alsager side rooted to the bottom with just 4 points from 10 matches. This should be a straightforward opportunity for the leaders to return to winning ways.
divisionWide: The chasing pack will be eager to capitalize on Sandbach's recent stumble. Second-placed Stafford Town, themselves on a recent loss, travel to Dawley Town on Saturday, while third-ranked AFC Bridgnorth visit Eccleshall in what could prove a compelling mid-table encounter. Wolverhampton Casuals, currently fifth and in strong recent form with three successive wins, host Wednesfield Community at home. There's a notable clash between in-form Bilston Town (fifth, on a winning run) and struggling Foley Meir. Market Drayton Town face New Mills, Brereton Social host Widnes Town (bottom of the table, pointless this season), Cheadle Heath Nomads visit Telford Town (another struggling side), Crewe entertain Allscott Heath, and Shawbury United host Barnton in a fixture between two mid-table sides. Wednesday evening sees Brereton Social host Wednesfield Community in a midweek fixture.
